places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Gus rejoins the outfit as it finishes crossing; the wagon is swum over, Po serves molasses hailstones, and the crew camps on the north bank.

places.name: Augustus and Lorena's ridge camp
places.note: Lorena stays hidden in Wilbarger's tent within sight of the herd camp, watching for Gus; he returns to her at dusk.
places.location_hint: a short distance north of the Canadian River crossing, within sight of the outfit's wagon but too far to see detail

places.name: Fort Worth
places.note: Augustus jokes the crew looks scattered all the way back there; Call says Jake was gambling there.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Augustus and Lorena plan to travel with the herd as far as Nebraska.

places.name: Colorado
places.note: Augustus thinks Blue Duck is west, likely in Colorado.

places.name: Purgatoire River
places.note: Augustus suggests Call, Pea and Deets ride up it to hunt Blue Duck.

places.name: Nueces River
places.note: Newt remembers Sean O'Brien lying buried far back on it.

places.name: Canada
places.note: Bert asks if the treeless plain runs all the way there.

places.name: Powder River
places.note: Augustus jokes the hungry hands will eat the herd before reaching it.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call is determined to reach it first and pick the best land; Augustus predicts losses on the way.

places.name: China
places.note: Augustus muses he might go there once the outfit settles.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: camped on the north bank after crossing; Call camps alone a mile or two west

groups.label: Augustus and Lorena
groups.hint: at Wilbarger's tent a short way from the herd camp north of the Canadian
